veranderings.voor: Oom Gerrit het oor die heining gesê
veranderings.na: Oom Gerrit het oor die heining heen gesê
veranderings.rede: 'oor die heining gesê' can be read as 'said about the fence'; 'heen' makes clear he spoke across it.
A bare 'Mans' at the start of the sentence reads abrupt; 'Werkers' is the natural word for the people repairing the pipe.

veranderings.voor: Water gaan eerste na drink en kos
veranderings.na: Water is eerstens vir drink en kos
veranderings.rede: 'gaan eerste na drink' is wooden; 'is eerstens vir' states the priority naturally.
'uithou' is the idiomatic verb for a supply that must last a period of time.

vlae.teks: Thandi en haar maat Lerato het elke slag ses vol bottels gedra.
vlae.rede: The previous sentences put the bottles in a crate on a wheelbarrow, so 'gedra' (carried) may not match what happened; whether they carried them by hand or pushed the wheelbarrow cannot be settled without guessing the intended content.
